THE REGISTRATION OF ELECTORS ACT, No. 44 OF 1980
IN pursuance of Section 12(1) of the Registration of Electors Act, No. 44 of 1980, it is hereby notified that the revisionof registers of electors for the year 2016 has commenced, on May 16th 2016.
02. Copies of Registers of Electors now in force or of portions thereof will be exhibited by Registering Officersin their offices and following offices.

03. Every person qualified to be an elector in any Electoral District may ascertain whether his name in theregister of electors by perusing of the register.

04. From 16.05.2016 enumerators will distribute enumeration forms to chief occupants of each household toregister the names of the persons who are qualified to be registered as electors for the year 2016. The chief occupants arerequired to give the assistance to enumerators by furnishing correct information of all persons in his household who arequalified to be registered as electors.
